definition: An estimate of the remaining time, cycles, or distance an asset or component can continue to operate within functional limits before requiring maintenance or suffering functional failure.
A condition-driven maintenance strategy that uses sensor monitoring and analytics to evaluate asset condition and schedule maintenance prior to expected failure.
The predicted elapsed time between inherent failures of a repairable system during normal system operation.
The average time required to repair a failed component or system and restore it to operational status.
A systematic technique used to identify potential failure modes, evaluate their causes and effects, and prioritize risk mitigation.
